requirements: Projects have members (project_members). Members see the tasks of their projects and may add tasks to them. A task may be assigned to a user, who must be a member of the task's project; only the assignee may update a task, and it stays in a project the assignee belongs to. Nobody deletes tasks.
expected_properties: Tasks are only seen, added and changed by members of their project.
Only the assignee updates a task.
Leaving a project never grants access.
An assignee is always a member of the task's project.
Whatever is written can be read back.
The application role may only select/insert/update tasks and select project_members.
